'''May 2002 Livingston tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in New World Manga, Livingston, New Jersey on 25 May 2002. [[Drew Scott]] won it. It is known from Ted Panczyszyn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3691">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-05-26-regional-warmup-livingston-nj-5-25-02d3691/ regional-warmup-livingston-nj-5-25-02], DeckTech (Ted "Rogue15" Panczyszyn, 26 May 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-05-26-regional-warmup-livingston-nj-5-25-02d3691/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 25 May 2002
* '''Site:''' New World Manga, Livingston, New Jersey
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Players:''' 6
* '''Winner:''' [[Drew Scott]]
